title: Grateful Dead Live at McArthur Court, U of Oregon on 1981-08-16
lineage: MAC > Nakamichi CR-5A > Edirol FA-66 > Wavelab 2448 > CD-Wave (24bit output) > R8Brain > TLH > FLAC 1644 tagged. Transferred by Andrew F. 04/2016
source: AUD: Nakamichi CM300/CP4 shotguns > lead Sony D5 > Sony TC-D5M > Maxell MX-90's, FOB recording by Brian Schley.

ai_review.summary: Great‑sounding tape with a groovy Scarlet > Fire sequence and a joyous, high‑energy performance.
ai_review.review: The recording captures a surprisingly clear tape despite the challenging acoustics of the MacCourt venue, highlighted by a lively Scarlet Begonias → Fire on the Mountain. The show itself radiates positive energy from the whole band, especially Jerry, making it feel like a real gem for fans.

ai_rating.rationale: Show is rated excellent (5★) with strong positive energy; recording is good (4★). Weighted average yields ~4.6★.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Tape sounds great despite the venue’s poor acoustics; taper achieved a clear pull, though some ambient limitation is inevitable.

standout_songs: Scarlet Begonias > Fire on the Mountain
show_quality.setlist_flow: The concert flows with joyous energy and cohesive transitions, making it feel especially special compared to typical East‑Coast shows.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Reviewers note a strong positive vibe coming from Jerry and the band, describing their joy and energy.
